```{r}

# ============================================================
# UK HOUSE PRICE ANALYSIS DASHBOARD
# HM Land Registry - Average Price by Property Type
# ============================================================

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(janitor)
library(scales)
library(plotly)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. LOAD AND PREPARE DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------

file_path <- file.path(
  "data",
  "HM Land Registry - Average price by property type.csv"
)

house_prices_raw <- read.csv(
  file_path,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = TRUE
)


house_prices <- house_prices_raw %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    region_name = str_squish(region_name)
  )

property_types <- c(
  "Detached",
  "Semi Detached",
  "Terraced",
  "Flat"
)

price_columns <- c(
  "detached_average_price",
  "semi_detached_average_price",
  "terraced_average_price",
  "flat_average_price"
)

change_columns <- c(
  "detached_monthly_change",
  "semi_detached_monthly_change",
  "terraced_monthly_change",
  "flat_monthly_change"
)

prices_long <- house_prices %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(price_columns),
    names_to = "property_type",
    values_to = "average_price"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    property_type = str_remove(
      property_type,
      "_average_price"
    ) %>%
      str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
      str_to_title(),
    average_price = as.numeric(average_price)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date))

changes_long <- house_prices %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(change_columns),
    names_to = "property_type",
    values_to = "monthly_change"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    property_type = str_remove(
      property_type,
      "_monthly_change"
    ) %>%
      str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
      str_to_title(),
    monthly_change = as.numeric(monthly_change)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date))

newcastle_name <- "Newcastle upon Tyne"

date_min <- min(house_prices$date, na.rm = TRUE)
date_max <- max(house_prices$date, na.rm = TRUE)

regions <- sort(unique(na.omit(prices_long$region_name)))

property_colours <- c(
  "Detached" = "#1f77b4",
  "Semi Detached" = "#ff7f0e",
  "Terraced" = "#2ca02c",
  "Flat" = "#d62728"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

format_price <- function(x) {
  scales::label_currency(
    prefix = "£",
    suffix = "",
    big.mark = ",",
    accuracy = 1
  )(x)
}

format_date_uk <- function(x) {
  format(as.Date(x), "%d/%m/%Y")
}

format_percentage <- function(x, accuracy = 2) {
  paste0(
    scales::number(
      x,
      accuracy = accuracy,
      big.mark = ","
    ),
    "%"
  )
}

# Common date-axis formatting.
# Exact dates remain available in chart hover information.
date_axis <- function() {
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "5 years",
    date_labels = "%Y",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  )
}

# Consistent Plotly layout for date-based charts.
date_plot_layout <- function(p) {
  p %>%
    layout(
      xaxis = list(
        tickangle = -45,
        automargin = TRUE
      ),
      legend = list(
        orientation = "h",
        y = -0.25
      ),
      margin = list(b = 100)
    )
}

# Calculate growth using the first and last available prices.
calculate_region_growth <- function(data) {

  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(average_price)) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    group_by(region_name, property_type) %>%
    summarise(
      starting_price = first(average_price),
      latest_price = last(average_price),
      starting_date = first(date),
      latest_date = last(date),
      absolute_change = latest_price - starting_price,
      percentage_increase = if_else(
        starting_price > 0,
        (latest_price / starting_price - 1) * 100,
        NA_real_
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. USER INTERFACE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ui <- fluidPage(

  titlePanel("UK House Price Analysis Dashboard"),

  sidebarLayout(

    sidebarPanel(
      width = 3,

      h4("Dashboard filters"),

      dateRangeInput(
        "date_range",
        "Date range",
        start = date_min,
        end = date_max,
        min = date_min,
        max = date_max,
        format = "dd/mm/yyyy"
      ),

      selectizeInput(
        "property_types",
        "Property types",
        choices = property_types,
        selected = property_types,
        multiple = TRUE
      ),

      selectizeInput(
        "regions",
        "Regions for comparison",
        choices = regions,
        selected = newcastle_name,
        multiple = TRUE,
        options = list(
          placeholder = "Select regions",
          maxOptions = 500
        )
      ),

      checkboxInput(
        "show_average",
        "Show average reference lines",
        value = TRUE
      ),

      checkboxInput(
        "show_newcastle",
        "Highlight Newcastle in regional charts",
        value = TRUE
      ),

      hr(),

      helpText(
        "The date filter applies to price, change and regional growth analyses."
      ),

      helpText(
        "Average reference lines are recalculated using the currently selected date range."
      )
    ),

    mainPanel(
      width = 9,

      tabsetPanel(

        # ====================================================
        # TAB 1: OVERVIEW
        # ====================================================

        tabPanel(
          "Overview",

          br(),

          h3("Newcastle upon Tyne"),

          fluidRow(
            column(
              4,
              wellPanel(
                h5("Latest average price"),
                textOutput("latest_price")
              )
            ),
            column(
              4,
              wellPanel(
                h5("Latest monthly change"),
                textOutput("latest_monthly_change")
              )
            ),
            column(
              4,
              wellPanel(
                h5("Regional growth ranking"),
                textOutput("newcastle_rank")
              )
            )
          ),

          h4("Monthly property prices"),
          plotlyOutput("overview_prices", height = "500px"),

          h4("Yearly average property prices"),
          plotlyOutput("overview_yearly_prices", height = "500px"),

          hr(),

          h4("Key observations"),
          tableOutput("overview_insights"),

          hr(),

          p(
            "Interpretation: These charts describe historical price movements. ",
            "They do not establish why prices changed or demonstrate that one ",
            "factor caused another."
          )
        ),

        # ====================================================
        # TAB 2: NEWCASTLE PRICES
        # ====================================================

        tabPanel(
          "Newcastle Prices",

          br(),

          h3("Monthly average property prices"),
          p(
            "Solid lines show observed monthly average prices. ",
            "Dashed lines show the average price over the selected period ",
            "for each property type."
          ),
          plotlyOutput("newcastle_price_plot", height = "550px"),

          hr(),

          h3("Yearly average property prices"),
          p(
            "Each point represents the average of the available monthly ",
            "observations in that calendar year. Dashed lines show the ",
            "average across the selected period."
          ),
          plotlyOutput("newcastle_yearly_price_plot", height = "550px"),

          hr(),

          h3("Price summary"),
          tableOutput("price_summary")
        ),

        # ====================================================
        # TAB 3: MONTHLY CHANGES
        # ====================================================

        tabPanel(
          "Monthly Changes",

          br(),

          h3("Month-on-month percentage changes"),
          p(
            "The zero line represents no monthly change. ",
            "Dashed coloured lines show the average monthly change ",
            "for each property type across the selected period."
          ),
          plotlyOutput("monthly_change_plot", height = "550px"),

          hr(),

          h3("Largest monthly increases"),
          tableOutput("biggest_increases"),

          hr(),

          h3("Largest monthly decreases"),
          tableOutput("biggest_decreases"),

          hr(),

          h3("Average monthly changes by property type"),
          tableOutput("monthly_change_summary")
        ),

        # ====================================================
        # TAB 4: YEARLY CHANGES
        # ====================================================

        tabPanel(
          "Yearly Changes",

          br(),

          h3("Average monthly percentage change by year"),
          p(
            "Each annual value is the mean of the available monthly ",
            "percentage changes in that calendar year. Dashed lines ",
            "show the overall monthly average across the selected period."
          ),
          plotlyOutput("yearly_change_plot", height = "550px"),

          hr(),

          h3("Overall average monthly change"),
          tableOutput("average_change_table")
        ),

        # ====================================================
        # TAB 5: REGIONAL COMPARISON
        # ====================================================

        tabPanel(
          "Regional Comparison",

          br(),

          h3("House price trends by region"),
          p(
            "Coloured lines represent selected regions. ",
            "The black dashed line represents the average price ",
            "across the selected regions for each month and property type."
          ),
          plotlyOutput("regional_price_plot", height = "600px"),

          hr(),

          h3("Regions with the highest and lowest growth"),
          p(
            "Growth is calculated between the first and last available ",
            "prices within the selected date range."
          ),
          plotlyOutput("regional_ranking_plot", height = "700px"),

          hr(),

          h3("Newcastle's regional ranking"),
          tableOutput("newcastle_ranking_table"),

          hr(),

          h3("Regional growth data"),
          tableOutput("regional_growth_table")
        ),

        # ====================================================
        # TAB 6: GROWTH DISTRIBUTIONS
        # ====================================================

        tabPanel(

        ),

        tabPanel(

          verbatimTextOutput("dataset_summary"),

          hr(),

          p(

)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. SERVER
# ------------------------------------------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # ==========================================================
  # FILTERED DATASETS
  # ==========================================================

  filtered_prices <- reactive({

    req(input$date_range)

    prices_long %>%
      filter(
        date >= input$date_range[1],
        date <= input$date_range[2],
        property_type %in% input$property_types
      )
  })

  filtered_changes <- reactive({

    req(input$date_range)

    changes_long %>%
      filter(
        date >= input$date_range[1],
        date <= input$date_range[2],
        property_type %in% input$property_types
      )
  })

  newcastle_prices <- reactive({

    filtered_prices() %>%
      filter(region_name == newcastle_name)
  })

  newcastle_changes <- reactive({

    filtered_changes() %>%
      filter(region_name == newcastle_name)
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # YEARLY PRICE CALCULATIONS
  # ==========================================================

  yearly_prices <- reactive({

    newcastle_prices() %>%
      filter(!is.na(average_price)) %>%
      mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
      group_by(year, property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        yearly_average_price = mean(average_price),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })

  average_prices <- reactive({

    newcastle_prices() %>%
      filter(!is.na(average_price)) %>%
      group_by(property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        overall_average = mean(average_price),
        overall_median = median(average_price),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # YEARLY CHANGE CALCULATIONS
  # ==========================================================

  yearly_changes <- reactive({

    newcastle_changes() %>%
      mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
      group_by(year, property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        average_monthly_change = if (
          all(is.na(monthly_change))
        ) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          mean(monthly_change, na.rm = TRUE)
        },
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })

  average_changes <- reactive({

    newcastle_changes() %>%
      filter(!is.na(monthly_change)) %>%
      group_by(property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        overall_average = mean(monthly_change),
        overall_median = median(monthly_change),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # REGIONAL GROWTH CALCULATIONS
  # ==========================================================

  region_growth <- reactive({

    calculate_region_growth(filtered_prices())
  })

  region_ranking <- reactive({

    region_growth() %>%
      group_by(region_name) %>%
      summarise(
        average_growth = if (
          all(is.na(percentage_increase))
        ) {
          NA_real_
        } else {
          mean(percentage_increase, na.rm = TRUE)
        },
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(average_growth)) %>%
      arrange(desc(average_growth))
  })

  newcastle_growth <- reactive({

    region_ranking() %>%
      filter(region_name == newcastle_name)
  })

  newcastle_positions <- reactive({

    growth <- region_growth()

    distribution_stats <- growth %>%
      group_by(property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_growth = mean(percentage_increase, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_growth = sd(percentage_increase, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_growth = median(percentage_increase, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    growth %>%
      filter(region_name == newcastle_name) %>%
      left_join(distribution_stats, by = "property_type") %>%
      mutate(
        z_score = if_else(
          !is.na(sd_growth) & sd_growth > 0,
          (percentage_increase - mean_growth) / sd_growth,
          NA_real_
        )
      )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # OVERVIEW KPI VALUES
  # ==========================================================

  output$latest_price <- renderText({

    data <- newcastle_prices() %>%
      filter(!is.na(average_price)) %>%
      arrange(desc(date))

    req(nrow(data) > 0)

    format_price(data$average_price[1])
  })

  output$latest_monthly_change <- renderText({

    data <- newcastle_changes() %>%
      filter(!is.na(monthly_change)) %>%
      arrange(desc(date))

    req(nrow(data) > 0)

    paste0(
      round(data$monthly_change[1], 2),
      "%"
    )
  })

  output$newcastle_rank <- renderText({

    ranking <- region_ranking()

    rank <- which(ranking$region_name == newcastle_name)

    req(length(rank) > 0)

    paste0(
      rank,
      " of ",
      nrow(ranking),
      " regions"
    )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # OVERVIEW INSIGHTS
  # ==========================================================

  output$overview_insights <- renderTable({

    data <- newcastle_prices() %>%
      filter(!is.na(average_price)) %>%
      arrange(property_type, date) %>%
      group_by(property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        observations = n(),
        first_date = first(date),
        latest_date = last(date),
        first_price = first(average_price),
        latest_price = last(average_price),
        mean_price = mean(average_price),
        median_price = median(average_price),
        change = latest_price - first_price,
        percentage_change = if_else(
          first_price > 0,
          (latest_price / first_price - 1) * 100,
          NA_real_
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      transmute(
        Property_type = property_type,
        Observations = observations,
        Period = paste(
          format_date_uk(first_date),
          "to",
          format_date_uk(latest_date)
        ),
        Latest_price = format_price(latest_price),
        Period_average = format_price(mean_price),
        Period_median = format_price(median_price),
        Absolute_change = format_price(change),
        Percentage_change = format_percentage(percentage_change)
      )

    data
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # OVERVIEW: MONTHLY PRICES
  # ==========================================================

  output$overview_prices <- renderPlotly({

    data <- newcastle_prices() %>%
      filter(!is.na(average_price)) %>%
      arrange(property_type, date)

    averages <- data %>%
      group_by(property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        period_average = mean(average_price),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    req(nrow(data) > 0)

    p <- ggplot(
      data,
      aes(
        x = date,
        y = average_price,
        colour = property_type,
        group = property_type,
        text = paste0(
          "Date: ", format_date_uk(date),
          "<br>Property type: ", property_type,
          "<br>Average price: ", format_price(average_price)
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = property_colours) +
      date_axis() +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_currency(prefix = "£", big.mark = ",")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Newcastle Monthly Property Prices",
        subtitle = "Dashed lines show the mean price over the selected period",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Average property price",
        colour = "Property type"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()

    if (isTRUE(input$show_average)) {
      p <- p +
        geom_hline(
          data = averages,
          aes(
            yintercept = period_average,
            colour = property_type
          ),
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.9,
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          show.legend = FALSE
        )
    }

    date_plot_layout(
      ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
    )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # OVERVIEW: YEARLY PRICES
  # ==========================================================

  output$overview_yearly_prices <- renderPlotly({

    data <- yearly_prices()
    averages <- average_prices()

    req(nrow(data) > 0)

    p <- ggplot(
      data,
      aes(
        x = year,
        y = yearly_average_price,
        colour = property_type,
        group = property_type,
        text = paste0(
          "Year: ", year,
          "<br>Property type: ", property_type,
          "<br>Average price: ", format_price(yearly_average_price)
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = property_colours) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_currency(prefix = "£", big.mark = ",")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Yearly Average Property Prices",
        subtitle = "Dashed lines show the mean price over the selected period",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Average property price",
        colour = "Property type"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()

    if (isTRUE(input$show_average)) {
      p <- p +
        geom_hline(
          data = averages,
          aes(
            yintercept = overall_average,
            colour = property_type
          ),
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.9,
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          show.legend = FALSE
        )
    }

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # NEWCASTLE PRICES: MONTHLY
  # ==========================================================

  output$newcastle_price_plot <- renderPlotly({

    data <- newcastle_prices() %>%
      filter(!is.na(average_price)) %>%
      arrange(property_type, date)

    averages <- data %>%
      group_by(property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        period_average = mean(average_price),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    req(nrow(data) > 0)

    p <- ggplot(
      data,
      aes(
        x = date,
        y = average_price,
        colour = property_type,
        group = property_type,
        text = paste0(
          "Date: ", format_date_uk(date),
          "<br>Property type: ", property_type,
          "<br>Average price: ", format_price(average_price)
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = property_colours) +
      date_axis() +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_currency(prefix = "£", big.mark = ",")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Monthly Average Property Prices in Newcastle",
        subtitle = "Dashed lines show the mean price for each property type",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Average property price",
        colour = "Property type"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()

    if (isTRUE(input$show_average)) {
      p <- p +
        geom_hline(
          data = averages,
          aes(
            yintercept = period_average,
            colour = property_type
          ),
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.9,
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          show.legend = FALSE
        )
    }

    date_plot_layout(
      ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
    )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # NEWCASTLE PRICES: YEARLY
  # ==========================================================

  output$newcastle_yearly_price_plot <- renderPlotly({

    data <- yearly_prices()
    averages <- average_prices()

    req(nrow(data) > 0)

    p <- ggplot(
      data,
      aes(
        x = year,
        y = yearly_average_price,
        colour = property_type,
        group = property_type,
        text = paste0(
          "Year: ", year,
          "<br>Property type: ", property_type,
          "<br>Yearly average price: ",
          format_price(yearly_average_price)
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5) +
      facet_wrap(~property_type, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_currency(prefix = "£", big.mark = ",")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Yearly Average Property Prices",
        subtitle = "Dashed line shows the overall mean for each property type",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Average property price"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()

    if (isTRUE(input$show_average)) {
      p <- p +
        geom_hline(
          data = averages,
          aes(yintercept = overall_average),
          colour = "#d62728",
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.9,
          inherit.aes = FALSE
        )
    }

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # NEWCASTLE PRICE SUMMARY
  # ==========================================================

  output$price_summary <- renderTable({

    newcastle_prices() %>%
      filter(!is.na(average_price)) %>%
      arrange(date) %>%
      group_by(property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        First_date = format_date_uk(first(date)),
        Latest_date = format_date_uk(last(date)),
        First_price = format_price(first(average_price)),
        Latest_price = format_price(last(average_price)),
        Average_price = format_price(mean(average_price)),
        Median_price = format_price(median(average_price)),
        Minimum_price = format_price(min(average_price)),
        Maximum_price = format_price(max(average_price)),
        Absolute_change = format_price(
          last(average_price) - first(average_price)
        ),
        Percentage_change = format_percentage(
          (last(average_price) / first(average_price) - 1) * 100
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # MONTHLY CHANGES
  # ==========================================================

  output$monthly_change_plot <- renderPlotly({

    data <- newcastle_changes() %>%
      filter(!is.na(monthly_change)) %>%
      arrange(property_type, date)

    averages <- data %>%
      group_by(property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        period_average = mean(monthly_change),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    req(nrow(data) > 0)

    p <- ggplot(
      data,
      aes(
        x = date,
        y = monthly_change,
        colour = property_type,
        group = property_type,
        text = paste0(
          "Date: ", format_date_uk(date),
          "<br>Property type: ", property_type,
          "<br>Monthly change: ",
          round(monthly_change, 2), "%"
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        colour = "black",
        linetype = "dotted",
        linewidth = 0.8
      ) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = property_colours) +
      date_axis() +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_number(suffix = "%")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Month-on-Month Percentage Changes in Newcastle",
        subtitle = "Dashed coloured lines show the selected-period mean; zero indicates no change",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Monthly percentage change",
        colour = "Property type"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()

    if (isTRUE(input$show_average)) {
      p <- p +
        geom_hline(
          data = averages,
          aes(
            yintercept = period_average,
            colour = property_type
          ),
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.9,
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          show.legend = FALSE
        )
    }

    date_plot_layout(
      ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
        layout(hovermode = "x unified")
    )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # BIGGEST MONTHLY INCREASES
  # ==========================================================

  output$biggest_increases <- renderTable({

    newcastle_changes() %>%
      filter(!is.na(monthly_change)) %>%
      group_by(property_type) %>%
      slice_max(
        order_by = monthly_change,
        n = 10,
        with_ties = FALSE
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(property_type, desc(monthly_change)) %>%
      transmute(
        Property_type = property_type,
        Date = format_date_uk(date),
        Monthly_change = format_percentage(monthly_change)
      )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # BIGGEST MONTHLY DECREASES
  # ==========================================================

  output$biggest_decreases <- renderTable({

    newcastle_changes() %>%
      filter(!is.na(monthly_change)) %>%
      group_by(property_type) %>%
      slice_min(
        order_by = monthly_change,
        n = 10,
        with_ties = FALSE
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      arrange(property_type, monthly_change) %>%
      transmute(
        Property_type = property_type,
        Date = format_date_uk(date),
        Monthly_change = format_percentage(monthly_change)
      )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # MONTHLY CHANGE SUMMARY
  # ==========================================================

  output$monthly_change_summary <- renderTable({

    newcastle_changes() %>%
      filter(!is.na(monthly_change)) %>%
      group_by(property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        Observations = n(),
        Average_monthly_change = format_percentage(
          mean(monthly_change)
        ),
        Median_monthly_change = format_percentage(
          median(monthly_change)
        ),
        Largest_increase = format_percentage(
          max(monthly_change)
        ),
        Largest_decrease = format_percentage(
          min(monthly_change)
        ),
        Positive_months = sum(monthly_change > 0),
        Negative_months = sum(monthly_change < 0),
        Unchanged_months = sum(monthly_change == 0),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # YEARLY CHANGES
  # ==========================================================

  output$yearly_change_plot <- renderPlotly({

    data <- yearly_changes() %>%
      arrange(property_type, year)

    averages <- average_changes()

    req(nrow(data) > 0)

    p <- ggplot(
      data,
      aes(
        x = year,
        y = average_monthly_change,
        colour = property_type,
        group = property_type,
        text = paste0(
          "Year: ", year,
          "<br>Property type: ", property_type,
          "<br>Average monthly change: ",
          round(average_monthly_change, 2), "%"
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_point(size = 1.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        colour = "black",
        linetype = "dotted"
      ) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = property_colours) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_number(suffix = "%")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Average Monthly House Price Changes by Year",
        subtitle = "Dashed coloured lines show the overall monthly mean",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Average monthly percentage change",
        colour = "Property type"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()

    if (isTRUE(input$show_average)) {
      p <- p +
        geom_hline(
          data = averages,
          aes(
            yintercept = overall_average,
            colour = property_type
          ),
          linetype = "dashed",
          linewidth = 0.9,
          inherit.aes = FALSE,
          show.legend = FALSE
        )
    }

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
  })

  output$average_change_table <- renderTable({

    average_changes() %>%
      arrange(desc(overall_average)) %>%
      transmute(
        Property_type = property_type,
        Average_monthly_change = format_percentage(overall_average),
        Median_monthly_change = format_percentage(overall_median)
      )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # REGIONAL PRICE COMPARISON
  # ==========================================================

  output$regional_price_plot <- renderPlotly({

    data <- filtered_prices() %>%
      filter(
        region_name %in% input$regions,
        !is.na(average_price)
      ) %>%
      arrange(region_name, property_type, date)

    req(nrow(data) > 0)

    regional_average <- data %>%
      group_by(date, property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        regional_mean = mean(average_price),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    p <- ggplot(
      data,
      aes(
        x = date,
        y = average_price,
        colour = region_name,
        group = interaction(region_name, property_type),
        text = paste0(
          "Region: ", region_name,
          "<br>Date: ", format_date_uk(date),
          "<br>Property type: ", property_type,
          "<br>Average price: ", format_price(average_price)
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 0.7) +
      facet_wrap(~property_type, scales = "free_y") +
      date_axis() +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_currency(prefix = "£", big.mark = ",")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Average House Prices by Region",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Average property price",
        colour = "Region"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")

    # Black dashed line: mean across the selected regions.
    p <- p +
      geom_line(
        data = regional_average,
        aes(
          x = date,
          y = regional_mean,
          group = property_type
        ),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        colour = "black",
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 1
      )

    date_plot_layout(
      ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
    )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # REGIONAL GROWTH RANKINGS
  # ==========================================================

  output$regional_ranking_plot <- renderPlotly({

    ranking <- region_ranking()

    req(nrow(ranking) > 0)

    top_15 <- ranking %>%
      slice_max(
        order_by = average_growth,
        n = 15,
        with_ties = FALSE
      ) %>%
      mutate(group = "15 highest increases")

    bottom_15 <- ranking %>%
      slice_min(
        order_by = average_growth,
        n = 15,
        with_ties = FALSE
      ) %>%
      mutate(group = "15 lowest increases")

    comparison <- bind_rows(top_15, bottom_15) %>%
      distinct(region_name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(
        region_label = if_else(
          region_name == newcastle_name & isTRUE(input$show_newcastle),
          paste0(region_name, " (Newcastle)"),
          region_name
        ),
        is_newcastle = region_name == newcastle_name
      )

    p <- ggplot(
      comparison,
      aes(
        x = reorder(region_label, average_growth),
        y = average_growth,
        fill = group,
        text = paste0(
          "Region: ", region_name,
          "<br>Average growth: ",
          format_percentage(average_growth)
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_col() +
      coord_flip() +
      facet_wrap(~group, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_y_continuous(
        labels = label_number(suffix = "%")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Regions with the Highest and Lowest House Price Growth",
        subtitle = "Growth is measured between the first and last available observations",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Average percentage increase"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "none")

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # NEWCASTLE RANKING TABLE
  # ==========================================================

  output$newcastle_ranking_table <- renderTable({

    ranking <- region_ranking() %>%
      mutate(
        rank = min_rank(desc(average_growth)),
        total_regions = n()
      )

    ranking %>%
      filter(region_name == newcastle_name) %>%
      transmute(
        Rank = rank,
        Total_regions = total_regions,
        Region = region_name,
        Average_growth = format_percentage(average_growth)
      )
  })

  output$regional_growth_table <- renderTable({

    ranking <- region_ranking()

    ranking %>%
      mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
      filter(
        region_name == newcastle_name |
          region_name %in% c(
            head(ranking$region_name, 15),
            tail(ranking$region_name, 15)
          )
      ) %>%
      transmute(
        Rank = rank,
        Region = region_name,
        Average_growth = format_percentage(average_growth)
      ) %>%
      arrange(Rank)
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # OVERALL GROWTH DISTRIBUTION
  # ==========================================================

  output$overall_distribution_plot <- renderPlotly({

    ranking <- region_ranking()

    req(nrow(ranking) > 1)

    mean_growth <- mean(ranking$average_growth, na.rm = TRUE)
    median_growth <- median(ranking$average_growth, na.rm = TRUE)

    newcastle_value <- ranking %>%
      filter(region_name == newcastle_name) %>%
      pull(average_growth)

    p <- ggplot(
      ranking,
      aes(
        x = average_growth,
        text = paste0(
          "Region: ", region_name,
          "<br>Growth: ", format_percentage(average_growth)
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_histogram(
        aes(y = after_stat(density)),
        bins = 30,
        fill = "lightgrey",
        colour = "white"
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = mean_growth,
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 1
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = median_growth,
        colour = "blue",
        linewidth = 1,
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Regional House Price Growth Distribution",
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Mean: ", format_percentage(mean_growth),
          " | Median: ", format_percentage(median_growth)
        ),
        x = "House price growth (%)",
        y = "Density"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()

    if (length(newcastle_value) > 0) {
      p <- p +
        geom_vline(
          xintercept = newcastle_value[1],
          colour = "red",
          linewidth = 1.2,
          linetype = "dotdash"
        )
    }

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # PROPERTY-TYPE GROWTH DISTRIBUTIONS
  # ==========================================================

  output$property_distribution_plot <- renderPlotly({

    growth <- region_growth() %>%
      filter(!is.na(percentage_increase))

    positions <- newcastle_positions()

    req(nrow(growth) > 0)

    distribution_stats <- growth %>%
      group_by(property_type) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_growth = mean(percentage_increase),
        median_growth = median(percentage_increase),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    p <- ggplot(
      growth,
      aes(
        x = percentage_increase,
        text = paste0(
          "Region: ", region_name,
          "<br>Property type: ", property_type,
          "<br>Growth: ", format_percentage(percentage_increase)
        )
      )
    ) +
      geom_histogram(
        aes(y = after_stat(density)),
        bins = 25,
        fill = "grey80",
        colour = "white"
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~property_type, scales = "free") +
      geom_vline(
        data = distribution_stats,
        aes(xintercept = mean_growth),
        colour = "black",
        linewidth = 0.9,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        data = distribution_stats,
        aes(xintercept = median_growth),
        colour = "blue",
        linewidth = 0.9,
        linetype = "dashed",
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "House Price Growth Distribution by Property Type",
        subtitle = "Black line = mean; blue dashed line = median; red line = Newcastle",
        x = "Percentage growth",
        y = "Density"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()

    if (nrow(positions) > 0) {
      p <- p +
        geom_vline(
          data = positions,
          aes(xintercept = percentage_increase),
          colour = "red",
          linetype = "dotdash",
          linewidth = 1,
          inherit.aes = FALSE
        )
    }

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # NEWCASTLE PROPERTY-TYPE POSITIONS
  # ==========================================================

  output$newcastle_positions_table <- renderTable({

    newcastle_positions() %>%
      transmute(
        Property_type = property_type,
        Newcastle_growth = format_percentage(percentage_increase),
        Regional_mean = format_percentage(mean_growth),
        Regional_median = format_percentage(median_growth),
        Z_score = round(z_score, 2)
      )
  })

  # ==========================================================
  # DATA EXPLORER
  # ==========================================================

  output$data_preview <- renderTable({

    filtered_prices() %>%
      arrange(desc(date)) %>%
      select(
        date,
        region_name,
        property_type,
        average_price
      ) %>%
      head(100) %>%
      mutate(
        date = format_date_uk(date),
        average_price = format_price(average_price)
      ) %>%
      rename(
        Date = date,
        Region = region_name,
        Property_type = property_type,
        Average_price = average_price
      )
  })

  output$dataset_summary <- renderPrint({

    data <- filtered_prices()

    cat("Filtered rows:", nrow(data), "\n")
    cat("Regions:", n_distinct(data$region_name), "\n")
    cat("Property types:", n_distinct(data$property_type), "\n")

    if (nrow(data) > 0) {
      cat(
        "Date range:",
        format_date_uk(min(data$date, na.rm = TRUE)),
        "to",
        format_date_uk(max(data$date, na.rm = TRUE)),
        "\n"
      )
    }

    cat(
      "Missing average prices:",
      sum(is.na(data$average_price)),
      "\n"
    )
  })
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. RUN THE DASHBOARD
# ------------------------------------------------------------

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

```
